source_text: General procedure B was applied to 2,7-dimethylquinoline (157 mg, 1.00mmol). The reaction was stirred at room  temperature  (25  °C)  for  72  hours.  Analysis  by  GC-MS  showed  a  95:5  mixture  of  2  monoborylated products. Volatiles were removed from the reaction under reduced pressure and the remaining residue was purified  by  silica  gel  flash-column  chromatography  with  gradient  elution  of  MeOH/DCM  from  0.5 -12.5% over 25 column volumes, affording     the major isomer, 2,7-dimethyl-4-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-[1,3,2]dioxaborolan-2-yl)quinoline, as an off-white solid (226 mg, 80%); m.p.108 -109 °C
